clues.text: In Egypt, the LORD told Moses there would be one more of these, and then Pharaoh would let Israel go.
Aaron ran into the crowd with a censer and stood between the living and the dead until this stopped.
At Peor, Phinehas drove his spear through an Israelite and a Midianite woman, and this was halted after 24,000 died.
The prophet Gad offered David three years of famine, three months of fleeing, or three days of this.
David bought the threshing floor of Araunah and built an altar there so this upon the people would stop.
In the wilderness, the LORD sent this on the people because of the calf that Aaron had made.
Jeremiah warned that whoever stayed in besieged Jerusalem would die by sword, by famine, and by this.
